# [Your Brand]s — AI-Powered Home Construction Platform

> [Your Brand]s is India's leading turnkey home construction platform, leveraging AI design tools, transparent pricing, and real-time live site tracking.

## Core Products & Services
- **Turnkey Home Construction**: Complete end-to-end design, civil construction, and interior design across India.
- **Pricing**: Transparent packages starting from ₹1,499/sq. ft. up to ₹3,500/sq. ft.
- **AI Design Tools**: AI 3D floor plan generation and real-time cost estimation.
- **Live Site Tracking**: 24/7 camera access and milestone-based progress tracking for homeowners.
